related.title: Sigma：跨後端轉換與偵測回歸管線
related.titleEn: Sigma: cross-backend conversion and detection regression
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付混淆矩陣、三個指標、基準率說明與閾值選擇理由。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the confusion matrix, three metrics, base-rate explanation and threshold rationale.
related.difference: 固定規則、轉換器與欄位映射版本，以同一組合成事件比較三種後端的命中集合。
related.differenceEn: Pin rule, converter and field-mapping versions, then compare hit sets across three backends using identical synthetic events.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: Precision=TP/(TP+FP)；FPR=FP/(FP+TN)；兩者回答不同問題，不能互換。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 10000筆合成事件中100筆需調查，偵測80筆；9900筆良性中99筆誤報。 Recall=80%；FPR=99/9900=1%；precision=80/(80+99)=44.6927%。
回歸一致率=符合預期的案例後端配對/所有配對；查詢成功編譯不保證命中語義正確。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 80個標籤案例在3個後端測試，共240個判定；其中234個符合預期。 一致率234/240=97.5%；6個差異必須回到欄位與型別檢查。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Precision=TP/(TP+FP), whereas FPR=FP/(FP+TN); they answer different questions. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Of 10000 synthetic events, 100 need investigation and 80 are detected; 99 of 9900 benign events generate false alarms. Recall is 80%, FPR is 1%, and precision=80/(80+99)=44.6927%.

Regression agreement counts expected case-backend decisions; successful query compilation does not prove semantic equivalence. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Eighty labeled fixtures tested on three backends produce 240 decisions, of which 234 match expectations. Agreement=234/240=97.5%; investigate the six differences through fields and types.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Timesketch：假說、反證與可追溯故事
related.titleEn: Timesketch: hypotheses, counterevidence and traceable narratives
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付混淆矩陣、三個指標、基準率說明與閾值選擇理由。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the confusion matrix, three metrics, base-rate explanation and threshold rationale.
related.difference: 每個故事主張連到事件ID與來源，將支持、矛盾與未知證據分欄，避免只收集支持說法的事件。
related.differenceEn: Link each narrative claim to event IDs and sources, separating supporting, contradictory and unknown evidence to avoid confirmation bias.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: Precision=TP/(TP+FP)；FPR=FP/(FP+TN)；兩者回答不同問題，不能互換。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 10000筆合成事件中100筆需調查，偵測80筆；9900筆良性中99筆誤報。 Recall=80%；FPR=99/9900=1%；precision=80/(80+99)=44.6927%。
有佐證主張率=至少有獨立佐證的主張/所有主張；事件多不一定代表獨立來源多。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 合成故事有18個主張，12個有獨立佐證，3個被證據反駁，3個仍未知。 有佐證主張率12/18=66.6667%；反駁與未知合計6項不能寫成確定事實。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Precision=TP/(TP+FP), whereas FPR=FP/(FP+TN); they answer different questions. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Of 10000 synthetic events, 100 need investigation and 80 are detected; 99 of 9900 benign events generate false alarms. Recall is 80%, FPR is 1%, and precision=80/(80+99)=44.6927%.

Corroborated-claim rate counts claims with independent support; many events do not necessarily mean many independent sources. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. A synthetic narrative has eighteen claims: twelve independently supported, three contradicted and three unresolved. Corroborated-claim rate=66.6667%; the six contradicted or unresolved claims cannot be stated as facts.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
